entities.summary: Igor Ivanovich Kshinin is a retired male boxer from Russia. He represented his native country at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, where he was stopped in the second round of the men's heavyweight division by Germany's eventual bronze medalist Luan Krasniqi. Igor Kshinin was a athletes & competitors from Volgograd (b. 1972-06-13, Volgograd). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
